source.interpretation: The text calls for two neighboring tabulated daily rows, not an elapsed two-whole-day interpolation interval. Its first operator obtains M from adjacent C; the second obtains daily message S from neighboring M. This is a Qing retrospective explanation, not literal provenance of the G893 source-original printing process.
